name: Cocoro@Function! NEO
original_name: ココロ＠ファンクション！ NEO（Network Enhanced Operation）
source:
This is the fandisk for Cocoro@Function!. It includes an after story for Mina and Hijiri, an ‘if’ story for subheroine Chie where Taiyou did not create the CFC, and a full story with Asagao and Bell which follows Asagao’s route in the original game. Some H scenes will also use the motion event movie system from Konosora SP.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/11/09/november-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是《Cocoro@Function！》的粉丝碟。收录美奈与圣的后日谈、女配千绘的“如果”故事（泰阳没有创造CFC），以及完整的朝颜与贝尔故事，该故事接续原作中的朝颜路线。部分色情场景还会使用《Konosora SP》中的动态事件影片系统。

[译自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/11/09/november-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]]
